t: This is the Catholic church of St Francis de Sales and St Gertrude in Stockwell. It was designed by the architect Francis William Tasker, who built Catholic churches across England in the late nineteenth century. The dedication joins two saints. Francis de Sales was Bishop of Geneva, known for his gentle approach to the religious divisions of his time, and for his book, Introduction to the Devout Life. Gertrude the Great was a German Benedictine nun and mystic, a member of the monastery at Helfta.
